core_obligations: A presheaf on (Sch/S)_ph is a sheaf iff it is a sheaf for Zariski coverings and F(U) -> F(V) identifies F(U) with the equalizer of F(V) => F(V x_U V) for every proper surjective V -> U; in the presence of (1) property (2) is equivalent to its affine-U version (2') (proof lines: gluing via proper-surjective refinements and the (2)/(2') equivalence).
